0022600038.text: The Grizzlies (7-4, 4th in the Southwest, 2.5 games back) are 5-0 on the road but 2-4 at home, and they come in on a one-game losing streak after going 6-4 over their last ten. The Pelicans (4-8, 5th in the Southwest, 6 games back) have lost four straight and are 1-4 on the road. Memphis is missing Quinten Post (head), Richie Saunders (knee, surgery) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness), while New Orleans is without Bennedict Mathurin (thumb sprain), Trendon Watford (ankle sprain), Trey Murphy III (knee tendinitis) and Yves Missi (knee bruise). The Grizzlies trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after a 135-134 home loss on November 2, and the teams split their 2025-26 meetings 2-2; this game is part of the Emirates NBA Cup, West Group B.
